manifest.name: 持久化交互示例
manifest.description: 展示 sdk.state、sdk.setState 和选择回传。不是业务数据写入工具。

source: export default function mount(root, props, sdk) { let count = Number(sdk.state.count || 0); const button = h('button', {onclick: () => { count += 1; button.textContent = '计数 ' + count; sdk.setState({count}); sdk.select({key:'counter',excerpt:'用户计数：' + count,resourceIds:[]}); }}, '计数 ' + count); root.append(h('h3',{},props.title || '交互计数器'),button); return () => root.replaceChildren(); }
